name: PICO Manufacturing Sales Corporation
old_description: Since 1931, Pico has been family-owned and operated, and we’ve earned our reputation as the premier resource for all aspects of your garment and brand building needs. Innovation, product design, merchandising, and package design dictate our high-quality underwear and sleepwear for men, women, and children imports.
about:
PICO Manufacturing Sales Corporation was founded in 1931 in New York, New York, and has remained family-owned and operated since its inception. In 1958, Ira Litt joined the company and established its headquarters in the Empire State Building, situating the business in the heart of the Garment District.

The company designs, develops, and manufactures a full range of underwear and sleepwear — including boxer briefs, woven boxers, base layers, flame-resistant children's sleepwear, and active lifestyle apparel — for men, women, and children. Operations span product design, yarn and fabric development, merchandising, and package design. Production was relocated to Dayton, Tennessee in 1973, and the company handles orders ranging from 500 to 500,000 units.

PICO serves the apparel industry as a private-label manufacturer for department stores, mass retailers, and specialty stores, and acts as a strategic license partner for major brands in the underwear and sleepwear categories.

The company emphasizes its vertically integrated approach — developing proprietary yarns and fabrics, maintaining trend-focused design, and offering dedicated customer service throughout the process. It also highlights a sustainability commitment, holding BCI, OEKO-TEX, WRAP, Sedex, and CTPAT certifications, with a goal of 80% renewable energy use by 2021.
